fact: On 26 June 2025 INSBU held a workshop, supported by UNECA, to publicise the statistics law promulgated in 2023 and its application decrees 100/152 (CNIS) and 100/153 (INSBU) of 16 November 2022.
title: NewsStat, Bulletin trimestriel de l'information statistique de l'INSBU, juin 2025
publisher: Institut National de la Statistique du Burundi (INSBU)
